column1: # group   : train | eval | replay  (eval = paper benchmark, never train on it)
# source  : ms (ModelScope) | hf (Hugging Face) | url (direct http) | manual (login required; prints instructions)
# locator : repo id for ms/hf, URL for url/manual
# include : ';'-separated glob patterns for ms/hf (or '-' for everything). Macros expanded by the script:
# post    : none | unzip | untar | unzip_each | untar_each | un7z_each | coco2014_links ; chain with '+'. Archives are kept, extraction goes to dest.
#           coco2014_links symlinks train2017/val2017 images under train2014/COCO_train2014_*.jpg (RefCOCO refer files use 2014 names).
#           refer_umd / refer_unc rebuild REFER instances.json + refs(umd|unc).p from parquet shards (scripts/convert_refer_parquet.py).
#           nyu_mat converts nyu_depth_v2_labeled.mat (+ splits.mat in the same dir) to test/images + test/depths (scripts/convert_eval_sets.py).

column11: Official per-scene zips (HDF5). depth_meters is RAY DISTANCE: scripts/prepare_hypersim.py converts to planar z by default. Pick scenes with HYPERSIM_SCENES.

150 classes, 20k train. Not an evaluated benchmark -> safe for zero-shot. MIT moved the file to .../ADEchallenge/ (lower-case c).
Full ADE20K (3k+ classes) mirror; alternative to ade20k.

instances_train2017.json for scripts/build_instance_manifest.py --format coco

Edit triplets (parquet) for build_generation_replay_manifest.py --kind edit. Shard count via OMNIEDIT_SHARDS.
Full 1.4 TB; pass --only ultraedit deliberately. Prefer omniedit shards.
T2I pairs (--kind t2i). Synthetic images; only for text-to-image backbones.

1449 labelled frames; nyu_mat writes test/images + test/depths (mm PNG) for NYUDepthDataset. Paper Table 6/7.
Requires KITTI account. ModelScope mirrors (Damo_XR_Lab/KITTI_Depth_Dataset) are index JSONs only.
Requires account: gtFine_trainvaltest.zip + leftImg8bit_trainvaltest.zip, then scripts/setup_cityscapes_official.py. Paper Table 2 (val). Using train breaks zero-shot.

column11: val/{indoors,outdoor}/scene_*/scan_*/*.png + *_depth.npy + *_depth_mask.npy -> DIODEDataset. Paper Table 6 (DIODE-Indoor).
*_normal.npy next to the RGB -> DIODENormalDataset. Paper Table 7 (DIODE-indoor).
Undistorted DSLR images per scene. Needs the `7z` tool (p7zip). Paper Table 6.
<scene>/ground_truth_depth/dslr_images/* raw float32 metres -> ETH3DDataset.
ImgEdit-Bench only (50 MB); the ImgEdit *train* split is deliberately not registered (it is this benchmark's source). Paper Appendix D.

Official annotations, all 7 subsets x 3 annotator passes (COCO-style JSON, 168k image-NP pairs incl. negatives). Anonymous download verified 2026-10-23 - no HF gate needed. Images are NOT included: see saco-gold-images.

MetaCLIP images (6/7 subsets) from Roboflow Universe `sa-co-gold/gold-metaclip-merged-a-release-test` (free account); SA-1B subset from Roboflow or Meta's `sa_co_gold.tar` dynamic link (form). Place under saco_gold/images so annotation file_name paths resolve. Paper Table 3.
TUM dataserv link requires the request form; IBimsDepthDataset reads rgb/*.png + depth/*.png (mm). Paper Table 6.
The NYU .mat has no normal GT; Table 7 numbers use the community test normals shipped with DSINE's evaluation data. NYUNormalDataset reads normals/*.npy|png next to test/images.
Requires the ScanNet terms-of-use form; ScanNetNormalDataset reads scene/color + scene/normal. Paper Table 7.
Account required; nuScenesDataset projects LiDAR to CAM_FRONT depth. Paper Table 6.

Direct tar links moved (404 on 2026-10-22); download vkitti_2.0.3_rgb.tar + vkitti_2.0.3_depth.tar + vkitti_2.0.3_textgt.tar from the page. VKITTI2 ships depth (uint16 cm), not normals: VirtualKITTINormalDataset derives them from depth + intrinsic.txt in the paper frame. Paper Table 7.
Paper Appendix D generation benchmark; genai_prompts writes prompts.jsonl for GenAIBenchDataset.
